What does this PR do?\n\nAdds first-class XML support, mirroring the existing TOML / YAML / JSON5 parsers.\n\n```js\nimport config from \"./config.xml\";\n// or\nimport config from \"./data.txt\" with { type: \"xml\" };\n// or\nconst config = Bun.XML.parse(str);\n```\n\n### XML → JS mapping\n\nFollows the `fast-xml-parser` convention so the output shape is familiar:\n\n```xml\n<root version=\"1.0\">\n  <item id=\"1\">hello</item>\n  <item id=\"2\">world</item>\n  <empty/>\n</root>\n```\n```json\n{\n  \"root\": {\n    \"@version\": \"1.0\",\n    \"item\": [\n      { \"@id\": \"1\", \"#text\": \"hello\" },\n      { \"@id\": \"2\", \"#text\": \"world\" }\n    ],\n    \"empty\": \"\"\n  }\n}\n```\n\n- Attributes are prefixed with `@`\n- Repeated sibling elements with the same tag name become arrays\n- Mixed-content text is stored under `#text`\n- Text-only elements collapse to a string; empty elements become `\"\"`\n- Whitespace in text is trimmed and collapsed\n\n### Parser features\n\n- XML declaration / processing instructions (skipped)\n- Comments (skipped, including in prolog and after root)\n- `DOCTYPE` including internal subsets (skipped — bracket/quote aware, **not** executed)\n- `CDATA` sections\n- The five predefined entities + decimal/hex character references\n- UTF-8 input with BOM handling; namespaced names preserved as-is\n- Stack-overflow guarded recursion (`bun.StackCheck`)\n\n### Security\n\n- Unknown entity references are **rejected** rather than expanded, so XXE (`<!ENTITY x SYSTEM \"file:///etc/passwd\">`) and billion-laughs payloads are inert.\n- DOCTYPE internal subsets are scanned but never interpreted; they cannot redefine predefined entities.\n- Surrogate-half and out-of-range character references are rejected.\n- Overlong UTF-8 encodings of `<` do not smuggle tags.\n\n### Wiring\n\nSame pattern as YAML/TOML:\n\n- `src/interchange/xml.zig` — parser → `Expr` AST\n- `src/bun.js/api/XMLObject.zig` — `Bun.XML.parse`\n- `options.Loader.xml` (=21) / `api.Loader.xml` (=22) + all exhaustive switches\n- Bundler (`ParseTask`, `LinkerContext`), transpiler, runtime `ModuleLoader`\n- `with { type: \"xml\" }` in `js_printer` + module info\n- DevServer watch store, perf-trace events, analytics counter\n- C headers (`headers-handwritten.h`, `bundler_plugin.h`)\n- `bun-types`: `Bun.XML` namespace, `\"xml\"` loader, `*.xml` module declaration\n\n## How did you verify your code works?\n\n170 tests across three files:\n\n- `test/js/bun/xml/xml.test.ts` — `Bun.XML.parse`: basics, attributes, entities, CDATA, comments, PIs, DOCTYPE, whitespace, mixed content, unicode, namespaces, realistic RSS/SVG; 30+ error cases; `__proto__` / `constructor` prototype-pollution checks; numeric-string preservation (TOML #17926 analogue); a **security** block (XXE, billion-laughs, parameter entities, DOCTYPE redefinition, depth/width bombs, NUL/control bytes, overlong UTF-8, parser-differential boundary abuse, char-ref overflow); and four **fuzzers** (valid generated trees, byte mutations, random garbage, byte-by-byte truncation).\n- `test/js/bun/resolve/xml/xml.test.js` — `.xml` import, `require`, `with { type: \"xml\" }`, named export of root element, empty file.\n- `test/js/bun/xml/xml-bundler.test.ts` — `Bun.build` with `.xml` entry, `with { type: \"xml\" }`, error reporting with location, non-identifier keys (`@attr`/`#text`) round-trip.\n\nAll pass with the debug build; all fail with the baked/system
